purpose: B14-U2 bounded SECURITY DEFINER authoring capability that creates one self-scoped Event with initial Agenda, optional Life Area assignment and canonical description, location and per-item color metadata in the same transaction.

routine.return_type: TABLE(event_ref uuid, title text, created_at timestamp with time zone, agenda_revision bigint, agenda_parts text[], life_area_ref uuid, assignment_revision bigint, description text, location text, color_code text, replayed boolean)

state_history.current_binding: The capability returns the canonical Event descriptor, initial Agenda and optional accepted Life Area assignment. Schedule, Recurrence and Participation remain separate capability families.
state_history.chronology: Event creation, initial Agenda and optional organization/descriptor metadata are accepted in one authoritative PostgreSQL transaction.
state_history.immutability_policy: Same operation id and intent replays the accepted result; changed intent for the same operation id is rejected. Generic runtime descriptor UPDATE remains denied.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: The accepted B14-U2 authoring contract is evolved only through reviewed forward migrations.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
runtime receives bounded EXECUTE but no generic Event descriptor write authority
Life Area assignment is optional and no synthetic default area is created
description, location and item color are canonicalized inside the authoritative create transaction
initial Agenda remains Event-internal and atomic with Event creation
same operation/same intent replays while conflicting reuse is rejected
